text: dsh-websearch-keyless 是一个面向 DSH 的搜索集成插件：它将免密钥的 Tavily、TinyFish 和 Exa 后端注册为 web_search 搜索提供方，并通过 bundle patch 将 DSH 的搜索提供方指向插件。搜索会按顺序尝试三个后端，在某个后端失败、超时或没有结果时继续尝试后续服务，返回网页链接、标题和摘要，Tavily 还可提供回答内容。适合希望在 DSH 中使用网页搜索且不配置搜索 API Key 的用户。查询会发送到对应的外部搜索服务。

dsh-websearch-keyless connects DSH web_search to keyless Tavily, TinyFish, and Exa. It tries them in order, continues after failures or empty results, and returns source links and snippets. Users can search without configuring an API key; queries go to the selected service.
想让 DSH 不配搜索 API Key 也能联网查网页。
DSH 的网页搜索服务没有可用密钥时，有什么免密钥的搜索接法？
How can I add keyless web search to my DSH setup?
dsh-websearch-keyless 的功能「免密钥网页搜索」：DSH 调用 web_search 时依次尝试 Tavily、TinyFish 和 Exa，某个后端失败或无结果便继续切换，返回网页来源和摘要。
dsh-websearch-keyless 的功能「接入 DSH 搜索服务」：插件向 ctx.web 注册搜索提供方，bundle patch 将 web 服务的 searchProvider 指向它；搜索结果包含来源链接、标题和可用摘要。
dsh-websearch-keyless 使用前须知：搜索词会发往 Tavily、TinyFish 或 Exa；这些请求不需要 API Key。（见 lib/providers.js:22-25、125-160、179-191）

dsh-websearch-keyless README · dsh-websearch-keyless：**Make DeepSeek Harness's native `web_search` work with no API key at all.** Mirrors the three keyless search backends that OpenCode's `WebSearch` service ships with — Tavily, TinyFish and Exa — and registers them as a `ctx.web` search provider. [](https://github.com/lovehin/dsh-websearch-keyless/actions/workflows/test.yml) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) ---

dsh-websearch-keyless README · The problem：A DSH profile with no usable search provider falls back on
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`, which answers `web_search` through the DeepSeek **chat**
API. When that key is missing or invalid, every search fails:

```
DeepSeek API error (HTTP 401): Authentication Fails, your api key: ****d09c is invalid
```

dsh-websearch-keyless README · The fix：OpenCode's `WebSearch` service registers five providers; three of them run keyless. This plugin
mirrors those three, in priority order, falling through to the next when one fails, times out, or
returns nothing:

dsh-websearch-keyless README · The fix：| Order | Backend | Endpoint | Keyless signal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Tavily | `POST https://api.tavily.com/search` | `X-Tavily-Access-Mode: keyless` |
| 2 | TinyFish | `POST https://agent.tinyfish.ai/mcp` | `X-TinyFish-Access-Mode: keyless` |
| 3 | Exa | `POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp` | no key parameter |

No signup, no key, no config. Only `web_search` is taken over — `web_fetch` keeps using the
built-in HTTP provider.

dsh-websearch-keyless README · How this differs from other keyless DSH search plugins：There are several keyless plugins for DSH now. Some read public search endpoints directly (for
example DuckDuckGo HTML or Bing), which works, but tends to return thin snippets with no
first-party metadata.

This one calls the same first-party search APIs that OpenCode uses, in keyless mode:
section: How this differs from other keyless DSH search plugins

dsh-websearch-keyless README · How this differs from other keyless DSH search plugins：- real titles and body snippets rather than scraped result markup
- three independent providers, so one being throttled does not take search down
- two source files, zero dependencies, no build step, no DSH peer dependencies

text:
dsh-websearch-keyless README · Install：Replace `<profile>` with the profile you actually boot: `desktop` for the desktop app, `web` for
`dsh web`.

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:lovehin/dsh-websearch-keyless
```

The plugin manager adds it to both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`. Because it is a
**bundle**, its own `cordis.patch.yml` is applied automatically — you do **not** hand-edit the
profile's patch layer. Restart DSH (or reload the profile) and `web_search` works.

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Install：Confirm it took effect:

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -A3 "^- id: web"
```

You want to see:

```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: opencode-keyless

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Manual install：If you prefer to wire it by hand, or the profile is app-managed and the CLI refuses
(`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`):

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>
git clone https://github.com/lovehin/dsh-websearch-keyless.git \
  ~/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-websearch-keyless
ln -sfn ../../../local-plugins/dsh-websearch-keyless node_modules/dsh-websearch-keyless

Add the dependency to the profile's `package.json`:

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Manual install：```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-websearch-keyless": "link:/home/you/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-websearch-keyless"
}
```

Then append to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — **deleting the leading `[]` sentinel first if
the file is still empty**:

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: opencode-keyless
    fetchProvider: http      # REQUIRED — see Gotchas

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Verify：The test suite is dependency-free and runs on plain Node:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lovehin/dsh-websearch-keyless.git
cd dsh-websearch-keyless
npm test              # offline: parsing, fallback and plugin contract (14 tests)
npm run test:live     # live: probes all three backends against the real endpoints

`npm test` needs no network and runs in CI on Node 20, 22 and 24. `test:live` hits shared
third-party endpoints, so it is a manual check rather than a gate.

dsh-websearch-keyless README · How it works：```
lib/providers.js   keyless backends + fallback pipeline (zero dependencies, plain CJS)
lib/index.js       Cordis plugin: registers a WebSearchProvider on ctx.web
cordis.patch.yml   points the `web` service at the provider id, inserts the plugin
test/unit.test.js  offline suite (fixtures captured from live responses)

The registered provider implements the seam's interface verbatim:

dsh-websearch-keyless README · How it works：`available()` returns `true` unconditionally because none of the backends need credentials.
Failures map onto the seam's codes: `WEB_ABORTED` for cancellation, `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` when
every backend fails for a reason rather than legitimately returning nothing.

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Compatibility：Tested against **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3**. The plugin declares **no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer dependencies and
no `engines.dsh`**, deliberately — DSH runs `evaluatePluginCompatibility` against every manifest
before loading it, so declaring nothing means nothing can be unmet. It also uses no
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports, so it resolves with a plain `link:` and needs no build step.

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Gotchas：These three cost real debugging time. If you write your own DSH web provider, they will bite you
too.

**1. `fetchProvider` must be restated.** An id-targeted patch entry **replaces** the matched
plugin's `config` object; it does not deep-merge. The shipped default lives in
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`'s layer as `{ searchProvider: deepseek-official, fetchProvider: http }`.
Override only `searchProvider` and `fetchProvider` is silently dropped — every `web_fetch` then
fails with:

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Gotchas：```
multiple usable web providers are registered (deepseek-fetch-api, http); configure one explicitly
```

**2. A `[]` sentinel breaks appends.** A profile with no overrides yet has a literal `[]` as its
entire `cordis.patch.yml`. Appending blocks after it creates a second YAML document:

```
dsh: failed to parse overlay .../cordis.patch.yml: YAMLException: end of the stream
or a document separator is expected
```

Remove the `[]` first.

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Gotchas：**3. Do not add DSH peer dependencies.** Any `@deepseek-ai/*` peer range that does not cover the
running version gets the plugin skipped at boot:

```
dsh: skipping profile bundle "@anysearch/anysearch-dsh": Error: Plugin
@anysearch/anysearch-dsh@0.1.6 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.1-rc.3
```

If you must load a plugin whose ranges are stale, grant an exact-version exemption:

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Gotchas：```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile <profile> allow-version <pkg>@<version> \
  --dsh-version <runtime-version> --accept-risk
```

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING` | `searchProvider: opencode-keyless` is set but the plugin did not load — check the plugin is in `dependencies` **and** `bundles`, and that `node_modules/dsh-websearch-keyless` resolves |
| `multiple usable web providers are registered` | Gotcha 1 — add `fetchProvider: http` |
| `all keyless search backends failed` | All three endpoints refused; usually no outbound network, a proxy, or shared-quota throttling. Retry, or check `npm run test:live` |
| Search returns nothing | Keyless quotas are shared and can legitimately return zero results for an obscure query; rephrase |

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Uninstall：```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-websearch-keyless
```

For a manual install, remove the `dependencies` entry, the `node_modules` symlink, and the two
blocks from `cordis.patch.yml` (or point `searchProvider` back at `deepseek-official`).

dsh-websearch-keyless README · Notes：- Keyless mode is a courtesy quota on shared infrastructure. It can be rate-limited or changed by
  the upstream providers at any time; that is the trade for needing no key. If you need
  guaranteed volume, register an account with one of the three and add a keyed provider ahead of
  these in `PROVIDERS`.
- The regressions in [Gotchas](#gotchas) were all found by actually calling the tools, not by
  reading the config. Verify the neighbouring tool, not just the one you changed.

dsh-websearch-keyless README · dsh-websearch-keyless：**让 DeepSeek Harness 原生的 `web_search` 在完全不需要 API Key 的情况下可用。** 把 OpenCode `WebSearch` 服务里那三个免密钥后端 —— Tavily、TinyFish、Exa —— 注册为 `ctx.web` 的搜索提供方。 [](https://github.com/lovehin/dsh-websearch-keyless/actions/workflows/test.yml) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [English](README.md) | 简体中文 ---

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 解决什么问题：DSH profile 若没有可用的搜索提供方，就会回落到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` —— 它通过
DeepSeek **对话** API 来回答 `web_search`。一旦那个 key 缺失或失效，每次搜索都会失败：

```
DeepSeek API error (HTTP 401): Authentication Fails, your api key: ****d09c is invalid
```

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 怎么解决：OpenCode 的 `WebSearch` 服务注册了 5 个提供方，其中 3 个无需任何 key。本插件照搬这三个，按优先级
降级：某个后端报错、超时或返回空结果时，自动换下一个。

| 顺序 | 后端 | 端点 | 免密钥标识 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Tavily | `POST https://api.tavily.com/search` | `X-Tavily-Access-Mode: keyless` |
| 2 | TinyFish | `POST https://agent.tinyfish.ai/mcp` | `X-TinyFish-Access-Mode: keyless` |
| 3 | Exa | `POST https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp` | 无需 key 参数 |

不用注册、不用 key、不用改配置。只接管 `web_search`，`web_fetch` 仍走内置 HTTP 提供方。

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 和现有的其他免密钥插件有什么不同：DSH 现在已有几个免密钥搜索插件。其中一些直接抓公开搜索端点（比如 DuckDuckGo HTML、Bing）——
能用，但通常只拿到很薄的摘要，没有第一方的结果元数据。

本插件走的是 OpenCode 也在用的那三个第一方搜索 API，以免密钥模式调用：

- 拿的是真实标题和正文摘要，而不是抓来的结果页标记
- 三个互相独立的后端，挂掉一个不至于搜索整体不可用
- 两个源文件、零依赖、无构建步骤、不声明任何 DSH peer 依赖
section: 和现有的其他免密钥插件有什么不同

```sh

```

插件管理器会同时写入 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles`。因为它是以 **bundle** 形式加入的，
它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会被自动应用 —— **不需要**你手动去改 profile 的 patch 层。重启 DSH
（或重新加载 profile）后 `web_search` 即可用。

确认生效：

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -A3 "^- id: web"
```

应该看到：

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 安装：```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: opencode-keyless

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 手动安装：如果 profile 由应用独占管理、CLI 拒绝操作（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the
Electron application`），可以手动接入：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lovehin/dsh-websearch-keyless.git \
  ~/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-websearch-keyless
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>
ln -sfn ../../../local-plugins/dsh-websearch-keyless node_modules/dsh-websearch-keyless

在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖：

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-websearch-keyless": "link:/home/you/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-websearch-keyless"
}
```

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 手动安装：再往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加 —— **若文件里还是空的 `[]`，先把它删掉**：

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: opencode-keyless
    fetchProvider: http      # 必须写，原因见「三个坑」

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 自检：测试零依赖，普通 Node 就能跑：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lovehin/dsh-websearch-keyless.git
cd dsh-websearch-keyless
npm test              # 离线：解析、降级、插件契约（14 个用例）
npm run test:live     # 联网：真实探测三个后端

`npm test` 不需要网络，CI 在 Node 20 / 22 / 24 上跑。`test:live` 打的是第三方共享端点，属于手动
检查，不作为门禁。

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 实现结构：```
lib/providers.js   三个免密钥后端 + 降级流水线（零依赖，纯 CJS）
lib/index.js       Cordis 插件：向 ctx.web 注册 WebSearchProvider
cordis.patch.yml   把 `web` 服务指向本插件的 provider id，并插入插件
test/unit.test.js  离线用例（固件取自真实响应）

注册的提供方与 seam 接口逐字对应：

```ts
export interface WebSearchProvider {
  readonly id: string;
  available(): boolean;                                              // 廉价检查，不发网络请求
  search(request: WebSearchRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<WebSearchResult>;

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 实现结构：`available()` 恒返回 `true`，因为没有任何后端需要凭据。失败会映射到 seam 的错误码：取消是
`WEB_ABORTED`，三个后端都因**故障**（而非合法地返回空）失败时是 `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`。

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 兼容性：已在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3** 上验证。本插件**刻意不声明任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer 依赖，也没有
`engines.dsh`** —— DSH 在加载前会对每个 manifest 跑 `evaluatePluginCompatibility`，什么都不声明就
没有什么可被判不满足。它同样不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，所以用 `link:` 直接解析，无需构建。

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 三个坑：这三条都是真金白银踩出来的。你自己给 DSH 写 web provider 时也会遇到。

**1. `fetchProvider` 必须重写一遍。** 按 id 打补丁是**整个替换** config 对象，不做深合并。上游默认值
在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 层里是 `{ searchProvider: deepseek-official, fetchProvider: http }`。
你只覆盖 `searchProvider`，`fetchProvider` 就被静默抹掉，此后每次 `web_fetch` 都会失败：

```
multiple usable web providers are registered (deepseek-fetch-api, http); configure one explicitly
```

**2. `[]` 会破坏追加。** 还没有任何覆盖的 profile，其 `cordis.patch.yml` 整体就是一个字面量 `[]`。
在它后面追加内容会产生第二个 YAML 文档：

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 三个坑：```
dsh: failed to parse overlay .../cordis.patch.yml: YAMLException: end of the stream
or a document separator is expected
```

先删掉 `[]`。

**3. 不要加 DSH peer 依赖。** 任何不覆盖当前运行版本的 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer 范围，都会让插件在
启动时被跳过：

```
dsh: skipping profile bundle "@anysearch/anysearch-dsh": Error: Plugin
@anysearch/anysearch-dsh@0.1.6 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.1-rc.3
```

确有需要时，可以按精确版本放行：

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 三个坑：```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile <profile> allow-version <pkg>@<version> \
  --dsh-version <runtime-version> --accept-risk
```

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 排错：| 现象 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING` | `searchProvider: opencode-keyless` 配了但插件没加载 —— 检查它是否同时在 `dependencies` 和 `bundles` 里，以及 `node_modules/dsh-websearch-keyless` 能否解析 |
| `multiple usable web providers are registered` | 坑 1，补上 `fetchProvider: http` |
| `all keyless search backends failed` | 三个端点全部拒绝，通常是出网受限、代理问题，或共享额度被限流。重试，或用 `npm run test:live` 定位 |
| 搜到空结果 | 免密钥额度是共享的，冷门查询确实可能返回 0 条，换个说法再试 |

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 卸载：```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-websearch-keyless
```

手动安装的话：删掉 `dependencies` 条目、`node_modules` 软链，以及 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那两个块
（或把 `searchProvider` 改回 `deepseek-official`）。

dsh-websearch-keyless README · 说明：- 免密钥模式是共享基础设施上的礼貌性额度，上游随时可能限流或调整 —— 这就是「不用 key」的代价。
  需要稳定配额的话，去这三家任意一家注册账号，然后在 `PROVIDERS` 里把带 key 的提供方排到前面。
- 「三个坑」里的问题全都是**实际调用工具**才暴露的，光看配置发现不了。改动之后要验的是隔壁那个
  工具，而不只是你改的那个。
